description: Earth is pushed out of the solar system by giant engines — and humanity fights to survive the journey.

title: The Wandering Earth II
description: The prequel: how the planetary engines were built before the great migration began.

title: War of the Worlds
description: Tripods emerge from the earth and humanity flees. Spielberg's alien invasion.

title: Weathering with You
description: A boy who can make it rain meets a girl who can clear the sky. Makoto Shinkai's follow-up to Your Name.

title: What We Do in the Shadows
description: A documentary crew follows vampire flatmates in Wellington. Taika Waititi, Jemaine Clement.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young drummer enters the demanding world of an elite music conservatory. The intense drama asks what a person may sacrifice in pursuit of greatness.

title: Whisper of the Heart
description: A bookish schoolgirl discovers a boy who shares her dreams — and finds her own path. Ghibli's quiet gem.

title: Willow
description: A reluctant farmer must protect a baby destined to defeat an evil queen. George Lucas.

title: Wolf Warrior 2
description: A Chinese soldier single-handedly takes on mercenaries in Africa. The highest-grossing Chinese film ever.

title: Wonka
description: Before the chocolate factory, before the golden ticket, there was Willy Wonka — a young dreamer with a hat and a plan. Timothée Chalamet sings, dances, and charms.

title: X-Men
description: Mutants struggle for acceptance while Professor X and Magneto disagree on how. The modern superhero era begins.

title: X2: X-Men United
description: Stryker attacks the mutant school, forcing heroes and villains to unite.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
description: Wolverine travels back to 1973 to prevent a war that will doom mutants.

title: Yellowjackets
description: A girls' soccer team survives a plane crash in the wilderness — and 25 years later, the past returns.

title: Your Lie in April
description: A pianist who can't hear his own music meets a free-spirited violinist who changes everything.

title: Zodiac
description: The hunt for the Zodiac killer as told by the journalists and detectives obsessed with the case.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Andy Dufresne, wrongly imprisoned for murder, spends decades finding hope and freedom inside Shawshank prison. Widely considered one of the greatest films ever made.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ accidentally becomes part of every major American event of the 20th century. Tom Hanks won the Oscar for this beloved epic.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Quentin Tarantino's crime classic. Intertwining stories of hitmen, a boxer and a briefcase in Los Angeles — with dialogue that changed cinema.

title: Fight Club
description: A nameless narrator and the charismatic Tyler Durden start an underground fight club that grows into something far more dangerous. The first rule: don't talk about it.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
description: Eight years after Harvey Dent's death, Batman is forced out of retirement when the masked terrorist Bane threatens Gotham. Nolan's trilogy finale.

title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: The Empire hunts the rebels across the galaxy. Luke trains with Yoda and faces the most famous reveal in cinema history.

title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: The final chapter of the original trilogy. Luke faces Darth Vader and the Emperor as the rebels attack the second Death Star.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: An orphan discovers he is a wizard and enters Hogwarts, where he must stop a plot to steal a legendary stone. Where the Wizarding World began.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2
description: The final battle of Hogwarts. Harry faces Voldemort in the epic conclusion of the eight-film saga.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Dinosaurs are brought back to life on a theme park island — until everything goes terrifyingly wrong. Spielberg's groundbreaking blockbuster.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator and fights his way back to Rome for revenge against the emperor who destroyed his family.

title: Coco
description: A boy who dreams of music enters the Land of the Dead on Día de los Muertos and uncovers his family's hidden history. Pixar's love letter to Mexico.

title: Frozen II
description: Elsa follows a mysterious voice into an enchanted forest to discover the truth about her powers and her family's past.

title: Encanto
description: In a magical Colombian family, the only ordinary member — Mirabel — must save the family's miracle when the magic begins to fade.

title: Big Hero 6
description: A robotics prodigy and his inflatable healthcare robot Baymax team up with fellow tech geniuses to fight a masked villain in San Fransokyo.

title: Wreck-It Ralph
description: A video-game villain who wants to be a hero travels between arcade games and discovers he's the good guy all along.

title: Tangled
description: A princess with magical 70 feet of hair escapes her tower with a charming thief. Disney's retelling of Rapunzel.

title: Shrek
description: A grumpy ogre's swamp is invaded by fairy-tale creatures, so he makes a deal to rescue a princess — and finds love along the way.

title: Madagascar
description: Four New York Zoo animals are shipwrecked on Madagascar and discover the wild life they never knew they wanted.

title: Kung Fu Panda
description: A lazy, overweight panda is chosen as the Dragon Warrior and must learn kung fu to defend the Valley of Peace.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are transported to the Mushroom Kingdom, where Mario must save the world from Bowser.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
description: Miles Morales travels across the multiverse and meets an army of Spider-People — including a society that has other plans for him.

title: The Wild Robot
description: A shipwrecked robot named Roz learns to survive on a wild island and becomes the adoptive mother of a gosling. DreamWorks' animated masterpiece.

title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
description: With eight of his nine lives gone, Puss in Boots embarks on a quest for the mythical Last Wish — with Death itself hunting him.

title: Elemental
description: In a city where fire, water, earth and air people live together, a fire element and a water element discover how much they have in common.

title: Cars
description: A hotshot race car gets stranded in a forgotten Route 66 town and learns what truly matters. Pixar's road-trip classic.

title: Monsters, Inc.
description: Monsters power their city by scaring children — until a human girl wanders into the factory and changes everything.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A clownfish crosses the entire ocean to rescue his son Nemo from a dentist's fish tank. The film that made everyone love Pixar.

title: The Incredibles
description: A family of retired superheroes is forced back into action when a new villain threatens the world.

title: Ratatouille
description: A rat with a gift for cooking teams up with a hapless kitchen boy to become the chef of Paris's finest restaurant.

title: WALL-E
description: A lonely waste-collecting robot on abandoned Earth falls in love and follows a sleek probe robot across the galaxy, carrying the last plant.

title: Up
description: A widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with an accidental stowaway: a young Wilderness Explorer.

title: Toy Story
description: When a new space-ranger toy threatens his place in the bedroom, cowboy Woody learns what friendship really means. The film that started Pixar.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
description: A Viking boy who doesn't fit in befriends a dragon everyone fears — and changes his world forever. DreamWorks' best.

title: Prison Break
description: Michael Scofield deliberately gets himself locked inside Fox River State Penitentiary to break out his wrongly condemned brother, Lincoln Burrows, before his execution date. The escape plan is tattooed across Michael's entire body — but the prison holds secrets that make the plan far more dangerous than he expected.

title: Alice in Borderland
description: Ryohei Arisu, a bored young gamer, and his two friends are suddenly transported to a deserted, alternate-reality Tokyo where survival depends on completing deadly games — each card suit and number dictating difficulty and risk. Lose, and you are eliminated for real. Based on Haro Aso's manga.

title: Omo Ghetto: The Saga
description: Twins separated at birth reunite as adults on opposite sides of the law, as a street queen and her refined sister clash with family, crime and the Lagos underworld.

title: King of Boys: The Return of the King
description: Alhaja Eniola Salami is drawn back into the dangerous game of Lagos power politics, where loyalty is short and every throne sits on a bloodstain.

title: RattleSnake: The Ahanna Story
description: A remake of the classic Nollywood thriller — a desperate young man and his crew plan an ambitious heist, only to learn that crime comes with brutal consequences.

title: The Set Up
description: A young drug smuggler trapped in a deadly game must think fast to survive when a routine delivery spirals into betrayal and violence.

title: Ijogbon
description: Four teenagers from a rural South-West Nigerian village stumble on a pouch of uncut diamonds — and the fortune attracts danger that threatens to destroy their friendship and their lives.

title: Chief Daddy
description: A flamboyant billionaire industrialist dies suddenly, and his large extended family scrambles to inherit his fortune in this sharp Nollywood comedy.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: Tom Holland's Peter Parker is four years on from No Way Home, forgotten by the people he loves, and still going out as Spider-Man. Destin Daniel Cretton's Marvel/Sony film is the one filling cinemas in August 2026.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
description: The pups crash-land on an island of dinosaurs and have to stop Mayor Humdinger from wrecking it. Paramount and Spin Master's third PAW Patrol cinema film, in theatres August 2026.

title: The End of Oak Street
description: A suburban street is torn out of the present and dropped somewhere with dinosaurs. David Robert Mitchell's film, with Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor, opened in August 2026 opposite PAW Patrol.

title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
description: A cinema documentary about the global pop group KATSEYE, from Dream Academy through the run-up to their third EP. Directed by Nadia Hallgren. Limited theatrical dates from 12 August 2026.

title: Niu Lai
description: A tiny Chinese animation about a newborn calf, made by a son and his mother, that flopped then became a box-office meme. Also titled The Bull Comes. No official trailer has been verified.

title: Vishwanath and Sons
description: Suriya plays Sanjay Vishwanath, a pistol shooter still chasing a late career. Venky Atluri's Tamil-Telugu family film, produced by Sithara Entertainments, dated for theatres on 14 August 2026.

title: Jana Nayagan
description: Thalapathy Vijay's Tamil action film for KVN Productions, directed by H. Vinoth. Delayed, leaked, then released on 23 July 2026 after he had taken office as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.

title: Hope
description: Na Hong-jin's Korean creature film: a village police post and a group of hunters go after something in the woods near Hope Harbor. Out in South Korea from 15 July 2026; Neon dates the US opening 9 September.

title: Toy Story 5
description: Woody, Buzz and the gang meet Lilypad, a tablet that wants Bonnie's attention. Andrew Stanton's Pixar sequel opened 19 June 2026 and was still in North American theatres in August.

title: Call of My Life
description: Dammy Twitch's Nollywood rom-com: Soluchi, still getting over a breakup, takes a work call that turns into something else. Bluhouse Studios; cinemas in 2026.
